# The tolerated truth → internal roster.
#
# Every edge from a module on the truth plane into seam-tagged internal
# material, with the reason the material has not been folded into truth/
# proper. Truth is the deepest plane and imports only itself; a seam-tagged
# internal edge is TOLERATED WHERE NECESSARY, never encouraged, and folding
# the material into truth/ is preferred wherever a way exists.
#
# This file is a reviewed control, never a source. Nothing generates it and no
# generator reads it. `check:layering` reads the import graph out of every
# module's source bytes and the seams out of their header tags, then requires
# every truth → internal edge to be pinned here — even when the two seam ranks
# make the edge lawful. A lawful rank is the floor, not the licence: a new edge
# has to be written down here as well, by hand, in a diff a reviewer reads.
# That reviewed diff is what "not encouraged" means mechanically.
#
# Format: <src-relative importer> <src-relative imported> <why it stays>
# Comment and blank lines are ignored.

truth/Refusal.ts internal/refusals.ts schema-issue-bridge-owns-effect-schema-types
